pages.text: $(bold)Spear$()$(br2)How to obtain: build it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() - $(bold)spear head + two handles$().$(br2)Usage:$(li)$(bold)Hold right-click$() to charge: the tip rises and aims$(li)Release to $(bold)thrust$(): deals damage with a charging lunge$(li)After the charge ends there is a short $(bold)retract cooldown$() before you can charge again$(br2)The spear has full $(bold)first- and third-person animations$() (raise -> thrust -> retract).

$(bold)Combat notes$()$(br2)A dash-plus-damage combo: a full charge lets you stab and propel yourself forward at the same time - good for $(bold)engaging$() or $(bold)disengaging$().$(br2)The fuller the charge, the farther the lunge and the higher the damage.
